title: Run final browser and accessibility verification
description: Run the final representative browser suite and WCAG 2.2 AA checks against the staged artifact in en/fa, including keyboard, focus, assets, states, and responsive/reflow smoke.
acceptanceCriteria: Browser evidence includes login/dashboard, node/tunnel, port-forward/user/audit/tools/settings, diagnostics, en/fa, desktop/mobile, keyboard/focus, and static-asset checks
No page/console error, missing local asset, secret exposure, color-only state, or keyboard trap is observed in the covered scope
Known limitations are explicitly recorded and not described as full WCAG conformance

steps.details: Use the final artifact and temporary data, start the service with placeholder configuration, and verify no production endpoints are targeted.
Run TASK-51..TASK-55 flows in en/fa and record screenshots/DOM/console/network evidence for each covered route.
Run keyboard/focus, names/roles/states, contrast/target/reflow, and reduced-motion checks; record route scope and limitations.
Stop the service, remove temporary data/processes, and write `.agent/evidence/task-71-browser-a11y-verification.md` with pass/fail/unknown status.

technicalNotes: Screenshots are supporting evidence only; use browser DOM/AX/network assertions for pass/fail.
